items.source: Creates a new QueryEnhancerFactory for the given DeclaredQuery.
items.translation: 为给定的DeclaredQuery创建一个新的QueryEnhancerFactory。

items.source: Creates a new QueryEnhancer for the given query.

items.source: Returns whether this QueryEnhancerFactory supports the given DeclaredQuery.
items.translation: 返回此 QueryEnhancerFactory 是否支持给定的DeclaredQuery。
